commits.message: fix: retry SSO checks with matched browser headers
fix: restore numeric verification codes and add update check
显示账号中心各页面的创建时间
feat: send SSO to GrokIQ webhook

feat: add grok2api auto-import format toggles

Registration still writes all three JSON files, but remote auto-import now follows Build/Web/Console checkboxes. Build stays on by default; Web and Console stay off.

feat: skip flagged browser exit IPs on registration

Detect the proxy exit IP inside Camoufox, store it when registration is risk-flagged, and restart the browser to rotate off known-bad IPs. Re-check the IP at risk time because dynamic pools can change mid-run; if it stays the same after a few tries, continue and log clearly.

feat: show flagged exit IPs in the account center

Add a dedicated page to list and delete recorded browser exit IPs,
and surface per-account exit IPs in account details.
feat: add low traffic registration mode
chore: enable low traffic mode by default

feat: render GitHub release notes as Markdown

Show headings, lists, links, and code from Release body in the
update dialog instead of plain text.
feat: cache accounts static resources in low traffic mode
feat: add CPA registration risk check toggle
feat: reorganize settings into tabbed workspace

docs: note grok.com no longer issues bfs flags

Call out that the registrar cannot judge account risk without GrokIQ
account-level quality probes and automatic isolation.

feat: add low-traffic savings levels and shorten code wait

Cut email verification polling from 180s to 60s. Keep grok.com CDN
caching as the standard low-traffic mode, and let users opt into
caching accounts.x.ai hashed static assets for extra savings.

feat: interrupt browser launches and default to more savings

Stop now cancels in-flight Camoufox/Playwright startups, serializes
launches with a 60s timeout, and kills stuck local Playwright drivers.
Low-traffic mode defaults to caching accounts.x.ai hashed assets.

feat: receive GrokIQ account detection callbacks

Accept grokiq.account_result webhooks, persist the verdict on the
matching registration, and show 降智 status in the account UI.

refactor: accept GrokIQ notify callbacks

Expose /api/integrations/grokiq/notify as the async detection
callback, matching payment-style notify URLs.
fix: use notify wording on GrokIQ result fields

fix: rebuild web UI so GrokIQ notify results show

The notify callback was already stored, but the packaged frontend still lacked the result badges.

feat: treat GrokIQ degraded notify as bot risk

Keep the GrokIQ 降智 badge, and map degraded callbacks onto the original 风控标记, filter, and icon.

feat: move Outlook mailboxes after code timeout

Add a dedicated timeout group setting and move the mailbox there instead of only disabling it.

fix: keep signup navigation off the low-traffic request path

Waiting for full load plus intercepting every accounts.x.ai request was
turning slow proxies into 30s timeouts. Signup now waits for DOM like
login, and low-traffic mode only caches/blocks static assets.

feat: add GrokIQ degraded account filter

Treat GrokIQ degraded/quarantined verdicts as the dedicated risk filter, and rebuild the accounts UI so operators can list those accounts without mixing in other bot-risk rows.

chore: prepare v1.0.10 release

Document the low-traffic signup timeout fix and the dedicated GrokIQ degraded account filter.

fix: recache hashed JS and retry apt on arm64 builds

Low-traffic cache misses now fetch and store static assets again so
signup does not re-download the 1.8MB accounts bundle every time.
Image builds retry Ubuntu apt metadata to survive ports.ubuntu.com
mirror syncs during linux/arm64 tag publishes.

chore: prepare v1.0.11 release

Publish the hashed JS cache restore and arm64 apt retry after the
v1.0.10 GitHub Release was blocked by a failed multi-arch image build.

chore: prepare v1.0.13 release

Keep the v1.0.9 standard/more low-traffic modes, show and clear the
static cache in settings, and refill hashed assets after a cache miss.
Also retry signup navigation, add a GrokIQ degraded filter, and retry
apt on arm64 image builds.

feat: add relogin logs, stop control, and login hardening

Show live relogin logs in a dedicated tab with a stop button, skip leftover
bfs checks, wait for Turnstile before submitting, and treat Wrong email
address or password as credential errors instead of SSO timeouts.

feat: switch log search from filtering to find navigation

Highlight keyword matches in register and relogin logs instead of hiding
rows, and add previous/next jump with a match counter like editor find.

feat: skip high-risk low-traffic cache replay

Default new installs to standard savings. Scan cached accounts.x.ai JS, label Castle/Mixpanel/Turnstile/telemetry files in Settings, and fetch those chunks live instead of replaying them across profiles.

chore: prepare v1.0.14 release

Default low-traffic to standard savings, skip high-risk cache replay,
speed GitHub update checks to 15 minutes, and ship relogin logs with
find-in-place search.
